status: field contract published before selection; consume only after DATA_READY.json

api.load_sample: load_sample(uid, patch_id, data_root=None) -> dict; supervision/evaluation only
api.load_condition: load_condition(uid, patch_id, data_root=None) -> {C: float32[K,3,3], N: int, known_mask: bool[N], valid_mask: bool[N]}; known first
api.gaussian: gaussian(seed, free_count, fp32=False) -> RandomState(seed).randn(free_count,3,3); canonical implementation shared by B/C
api.training_time: training_time(t_seed) -> np.float32 sigmoid of one local RandomState randn
api.permutations: permutations(permutation_seed, N, K) -> free_order, corner_permutations_before_face_order, face_permutation; no RNG shared between cases

sample_fields.full_target: float32[N,9], row = original raw source face ID; official canonical corner order
sample_fields.pre_ot_full: float32[N,3,3], captured official pre-OT, row = source face ID; never reconstructed by dividing full_target
sample_fields.source_face_ids: int64[K], source IDs in BFS order
sample_fields.source_vertices: untouched raw vertices, not inference input
sample_fields.source_faces: untouched original int64 source faces, not inference input
sample_fields.source_face_vertex_ids: int64[N,3], source vertices ordered as corners of full_target
sample_fields.canonical_to_source_face: int64[N], official canonical row -> raw source face ID
sample_fields.source_corner_permutations: int64[N,3], stored corner -> original source face corner
sample_fields.transform: recorded official operation sequence, raw bounds and intermediate affine operands; same transform for all patches
sample_fields.interface: edge_source_vertex_ids[E,2] ascending; known_source_face_ids[E]; free_source_face_ids[E]; known_corner_ids[E,2]; free_corner_ids[E,2]; corners correspond to ascending edge endpoints in full_target; never passed to model
sample_fields.patch_metrics: K/N, area fraction, interface count/length and overlap matrix row

files.patches: data/patches.json, records list with uid and patch_id
files.splits: data/splits.json, train/validation/test lists of UIDs plus group provenance
files.manifest: data/manifest.json, objects list with hashes and source identity

inference_boundary: full_target, free_target, bbox, transform, raw source identities, full-object topology and interface are supervision/scoring only. Model inputs only C/free state/t/N/masks. Build C-only geometry from C.
coordinate_warning: pre_ot_full * 2 -> model full_target. Do not scale full_target or constraints again. Source rows and corner permutations must follow subsequent B-side free/corner/face permutations.
acknowledgement: Session B should read this contract and record its accepted hash in its own registration; A never edits B/C code.
